# DORASANI — Complete Catalog, Heritage & Storefront Dossier

> Canonical Domain: https://dorasanicollections.com/
> Last Synchronized: 2026-11-09

## 1. Brand Identity & Regional Presence (GEO)
- Brand Name: DORASANI ("A Symbol of Tradition" / "Where Heritage Meets Divine Elegance")
- Flagship Location: Flagship Handloom Studio, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Geographic Coordinates: 17.4156° N, 78.4347° E (Hyderabad, Telangana, IN-TG)
- Operating Hours: Monday – Sunday: 10:30 AM – 8:30 PM IST
- Customer Care & Bridal Concierge Email: dorasanisarees@gmail.com
- Primary Weaving Inspirations: Kanchipuram (Korvai pure mulberry silk & temple borders), Banaras (Kadwa brocade & floral jaal), Chanderi (handloom cotton & tissue pallu), Bhagalpur/Tussar, and Pochampally craftsmanship.

## 2. Shipping, Payments & Return Guarantees
- Free Shipping Threshold: Orders above ₹1,999 ship free across India.
- Standard Pan-India Shipping: ₹99 (below threshold). Handling time: 1–2 business days; estimated transit: 3–5 business days.
- Express Pan-India Shipping: ₹199 priority insured courier.
- Payment Options: Razorpay Checkout supporting UPI, Visa/Mastercard/RuPay cards, Net Banking, Digital Wallets, plus Cash on Delivery (COD) for eligible orders.
- Return & Exchange Policy: 7-day return & exchange window on unworn, unwashed garments with original tags and packaging intact.

## 3. Storefront Service Commitments
- **Thoughtfully Curated Fashion**: Premium fabrics and timeless designs
- **Secure Payments**: 100% safe and encrypted
- **Reliable Delivery**: Pan India shipping with care
- **Dedicated Guidance**: Here to help always in-store & online

## 4. Canonical Collections Directory
- **Shop All**: https://dorasanicollections.com/shop
- **Pure Silk & Handloom Sarees**: https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/sarees — Kanchipuram bridal silk sarees, Banarasi kadwa sarees, Chanderi cotton sarees, Tussar silk sarees, linen silk sarees, and organza tissue drapes.
- **Bridal & Festive Lehengas**: https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/lehengas — Hand-embellished bridal silk lehengas, zardozi wedding lehenga sets, pastel organza lehengas, and royal velvet lehenga ensembles.
- **Ethnic Wear — Anarkalis, Shararas & Salwar Suits**: https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/ethnic-wear — Embroidered floor-length Anarkali sets, floral organza shararas, Chanderi kurta sets, and South silk salwar suits.
- **Handcrafted Kurthis & Tunics**: https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/kurtis — Temple-zari silk kurthis and handcrafted celebratory tunics with coordinated woven dupattas.
- **Kids Heritage Wear & Pattu Pavadai**: https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/kids-wear — Authentic South Indian pure Kanchipuram silk Pattu Pavadai sets and ceremonial ethnic attire for children.
- **Festive & Temple-Wear Edit**: https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/festive — Handloom drapes and celebratory silhouettes curated for Diwali, Sankranti, Ugadi, Navratri, and family pujas.
- **New Arrivals — Latest Loom Editions**: https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/new-arrivals — Freshly arrived Kanjivaram, Tussar, organza, and bridal weaves straight from partner master weaving clusters.
- **Signature Bestsellers**: https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/bestsellers — Most-loved Kanchipuram bridal sarees, Banarasi silk drapes, bridal lehengas, and festive sets chosen by DORASANI patrons.

## 7. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) — Key Buyer Questions

### Q: Does DORASANI ship pure Kanchipuram and Banarasi sarees outside Hyderabad?
Yes. While our flagship studio is in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad (Telangana), DORASANI ships pan-India within 1–2 business days of order confirmation, with free shipping on orders above ₹1,999.

### Q: Are blouse pieces included with DORASANI sarees?
All DORASANI silk, organza, Chanderi cotton, and Tussar silk sarees measure approximately 6.3 meters and include an unstitched coordinating blouse piece (typically 0.8–1 meter) unless explicitly noted on the product specification.

### Q: Which payment methods are accepted on dorasanicollections.com?
Customers can pay online via Razorpay (UPI, Credit Cards, Debit Cards, Net Banking, and Wallets) or opt for Cash on Delivery (COD) at checkout where eligible.

### Q: How should handwoven silk sarees and bridal lehengas be cared for?
Pure Kanchipuram, Banarasi, Tussar, organza, and zardozi-embellished bridal garments require Dry Clean Only and should be wrapped in breathable pure cotton muslin away from direct sunlight. Lightweight Chanderi cotton sarees may be gently hand-washed or dry-cleaned.
